name: Loscon
blurb: A long-running literary science-fiction and fantasy convention held over Thanksgiving weekend in Los Angeles, presented by LASFS.

picks: Strange New Worlds, Star Wars Rebels writer

editions.evidence: Official dealers-room page: 'Set-up for the room will be November 26th & 27th, 2026' with Dealers Room hours 'Friday; ... Saturday; and ... Sunday' (loscon.org/dealers-room-lc-52/), matching LASFS's long-standing Thanksgiving-weekend tradition; third-party listings (10times, The Bookfest) independently give Nov 27-29, 2026.

notes: The homepage itself never states exact convention dates (only membership price-tier cutoffs), so dates were confirmed via the con's own Dealer's Room page plus corroborating third-party listings rather than a single explicit homepage sentence. Venue is called 'LAX Hilton Hotel' on-site; its formal name, Hilton Los Angeles Airport, is used here. The five Guests of Honor (Writer/Artist/Music/Fan/Science) are each a classic regional-SF-con honor role rather than a working-professional category, so most are filed as cat 'other' with their GoH role used as known-for since no further bio text appears on the page; Griff the Filker is filed as 'music' (filk is a folk-music subgenre).
